title: Local Credential Manager credentials
whyItMatters: Saved web, network and app credentials for this Windows account. Someone with the disk could take these blobs offline and try to decrypt them.
source: DPAPI and Credential Manager reference: https://www.windowsforensics.app/en/artifacts/dpapi-credential-manager (blobs under %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/Credentials)
notes: DPAPI-encrypted blobs in per-SID subfolders. Metadata only; no blob is opened or decrypted. Roaming copy is a separate rule.
